title: Uniform-budget endpoint: covariance decay and actual return to the strip reference

Independently justify complete-factor support dependence: each face touches <=4 factors, each factor <=10 links, each link <=4 faces, giving overlap row degree <=160 including self. Conclude global projector and state convergence under the uniform budget, without pretending the perturbation operator norm tends to zero.
